old_policy_position: nuclear favored subject to safety, finance, fuel, workforce, liability, upstream, climate, geopolitical and cyber/digital gates
new_policy_position: nuclear favored only where physical security, design-basis-threat, insider, drone/perimeter, transport, law-enforcement and security-safe-publication gates are also satisfied
rationale: Clean-firm public value cannot be credited if physical protection, insider mitigation or transport security evidence is untestable or unreviewable.

old_policy_position: general nuclear sensitive-publication controls existed for cyber, fuel, transport and safeguards tables
new_policy_position: physical-security-specific controls separate public scorecards from safeguards, layout, route, exercise, response and personal-security details
rationale: The cube must remain publicly challengeable without creating an attack-enabling publication package.

old_policy_position: physical security partly implicit in security/safeguards/cyber gates
new_policy_position: 18 explicit physical-security gates bind all nuclear service floors
rationale: Pro-nuclear scoring should not treat sabotage, insider, drone, transport or force-on-force evidence as background assumptions.
